sources.title: PhotoGuider - a Hugging Face Space by NeilLeeNTU
sources.snippet: This Space runs PhotoGuider adapted to Hugging Face ZeroGPU: one environment, fast mode only, the explainer in bf16. Its results are close to, but not identical with, the paper. 360° results are the precomputed user-study runs.
